## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile arena shooter inspired by Plants vs. Zombies: Garden Warfare 2 and Pixel Gun 3D.
- Deliver a playable game, not just a plan; make reasonable assumptions without asking clarifying questions.

## Requirements
- Create an original game rather than reproduce the named games.
- Support mobile touch controls and keyboard/mouse input.

## Decisions
- Built “Sprout Squad: Garden Brawl,” an original garden-themed arena shooter.
- Implemented three selectable heroes with distinct stats and abilities, three enemy waves, and win/defeat screens.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented responsive game UI, canvas arena, combat loop, enemy waves, hero selection, HUD, and touch plus keyboard/mouse controls.
- Fixed initial visibility of the center notice and end screen.
- Verified mobile controls at a 390×844 viewport: joystick movement and firing reduced ammo as expected.
- Verified all three waves and the win screen in browser gameplay.
- `node --check game.js` passed.

### Active
- Final review of browser console errors and any remaining gameplay issues.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Check whether the prior `/favicon.ico` 404 remains the only console error; address it if appropriate.
2. Run any final checks, then report the completed game and how to launch it.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game UI, controls, initial visibility states.
- `style.css`: Responsive visual design and mobile controls.
- `game.js`: Canvas rendering, input, combat, and game state.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started on port 4173 for browser testing.
- Initial browser console error was `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found) @ http://127.0.0.1:4173/favicon.ico:0`.
